## 9c928e7deebc

**Reproduced defect — advertised controls are silently ignored.** At source
SHA-256 `069aa512acffe80a75895b7485e8d0873015266ac782ee9230d0bd72f2cf47f3`,
`generate(991, 0, difficulty="easy")` produced byte-identical grids when called
with each advertised helpful texture (`default`, `warm`, `cool`, `varied`) and
with either advertised alignment (`row`, `col`). The exact grid, call, per-control
hashes and self-check result are in
`checks/audit/9c928e7deebc/control_counterexample.json`.

The strict defect scan independently reports four `texture-dead` warnings, one
blocking texture-domain-overlap issue, 94 strict-scalar warnings and a degenerate
texture that passes `self_check`; see
`checks/audit/9c928e7deebc-defect-lint/`. The combined audit also found no task
local/frozen tests and failed because no executable semantic contract is declared;
see `checks/audit/9c928e7deebc-combined/`.

This is an API/distribution finding, not a claim that the canonical Racket labels
are wrong. Suggested future repair: remove unsupported axes or consume and test
them exactly, pin `RULE_HASH`, add strict scalar validation, and declare a finite
teaching contract with a concrete shortcut witness.
